title: Prohibition: Mustn't
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes cómo expresar prohibiciones y reglas estrictas en el lugar de trabajo utilizando 'mustn't'.

parts.visual: Mustn't (must not) se usa para PROHIBICIONES y reglas estrictas. Significa 'no debes' / 'está prohibido'. You mustn't smoke here (No debes/está prohibido fumar aquí).
parts.audio: Mustn't, or must not, is used for PROHIBITIONS and strict rules. It means it is forbidden. You mustn't smoke here.

parts.visual: ¡Cuidado! 'Don't have to' NO es prohibición, significa 'no es necesario' (ausencia de obligación). You mustn't touch this (Prohibido tocar). You don't have to go (No tienes que ir, es opcional).
parts.audio: Careful! Don't have to is NOT prohibition; it means it is not necessary. You mustn't touch this is a prohibition. You don't have to go means it is optional.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta para expresar prohibición.

questions.question: You ____ smoke in the office. (Está prohibido).
Employees ____ share passwords. (Prohibición).
You ____ enter this room. It is restricted. (Prohibido).
We ____ be late for the CEO's presentation. (Regla estricta).
She ____ use the company car for personal trips. (Prohibido).
You ____ take photos here. (Regla).
I ____ forget to send the contract today! (Obligación negativa fuerte).
questions.explanation: Mustn't forget = no debo olvidar (es crucial).

questions.question: Visitors ____ walk without an escort. (Regla de seguridad).
You ____ open this file. It has a virus. (Advertencia fuerte).
We ____ leave the computer unlocked. (Política de la empresa).
You ____ wear a tie, it's Casual Friday. (No es necesario).
questions.explanation: Ojo: No es necesario = don't have to.

questions.question: You ____ park in the director's space. (Prohibido).
She ____ attend the meeting, it is optional. (No es necesario).
Contractors ____ access the server room. (Regla estricta).
You ____ talk during the presentation. (Prohibido).
You ____ use this elevator in case of fire. (Prohibición).
We ____ lose this client! (Prohibición/Fuerte necesidad negativa).
He ____ sign anything without reading it. (Advertencia fuerte).
You ____ bring food into the lab. (Regla).
You ____ pay for the coffee, it's free. (No es necesario).
questions.explanation: Gratis = no tienes que pagar (don't have to).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe 'mustn't' o 'don't have to' según el contexto.

questions.question: You ____ smoke here. (Prohibido).
Employees ____ share passwords. (Regla estricta).
You ____ wear a tie today. (No es necesario, casual).
We ____ be late. (Prohibido/Inaceptable).
I ____ forget to call him! (Fuerte recordatorio).
She ____ use the company car for vacation. (Prohibido).
You ____ take photos in the factory. (Regla).
You ____ pay for it. It's free. (No es necesario).
You ____ open that file. It's a virus. (Prohibición).
We ____ lose this client. (Fuerte obligación negativa).
